code: calculate_mean <- function(x) {     if (length(x) == 0) {       return(NA_real_)     }      values <- dplyr::filter(x, !is.na(value))      for (i in seq_len(nrow(values))) {       values$value[i] <- as.numeric(values$value[i])     }      return(mean(values$value))   }
